subject.title: Feature Request: Per-model turn limits with auto-revert

question: Should OpenClaw add a session-owned N-turn model lease for `/model --turns N`, fold this into the one-turn override API direction, or keep model switching persistent only?
rationale: Automation should not choose public CLI/API/config semantics for turn counting, warning timing, auth-profile preservation, and overlap with one-turn overrides.

options.title: Specify a unified lease contract
options.body: Define temporary model override semantics once, covering one-turn and N-turn leases before implementation.

options.title: Defer to one-turn API first
options.body: Keep this issue open but settle #83565 before designing multi-turn model leases.

options.title: Decline native leases
options.body: Reject native turn leases and document manual reset or operational policy as the supported cost-governance path.

recommendation.title: Specify a unified lease contract
recommendation.body: Define temporary model override semantics once, covering one-turn and N-turn leases before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is on the existing session model override and Gateway patch paths that would own the lease contract.
